title: The Model diagram, in the new terms
subject: Screen, chrome, content, unit, collection, item, field and overlay, drawn on the Docs tab

brief.background: The first board's notes showed that the vocabulary, not the drawing, was the obstacle, so this board draws the taxonomy that replaced it.
brief.methodology: Five sketches carry the three favored ideas and two new ones onto the Docs tab, with each term keeping one color throughout.

ideas.title: One sentence
ideas.commentary: Each term is learned from the job it does in a description the reader can check against the tab, so no notation comes first.
